ranks: Top-5000 gap, EDHREC ranks 2002–2870 (2026-11-12): the best-ranked of the 110 cards still missing from top-commander-cards.txt, each blocked on one small feature (B294) — built best rank first, no agents. Features: filter `thisWayBy: "you"` (Rise of the Witch-king; Deadly Brew fixed by the same ruling), `opponent-controls` `atMost` (Hagra Mauling), `double-counters` on you (Aetheric Amplifier), filter `played` (Deep Gnome Terramancer), `additional-beginning-phase` (the user said build it: Sphinx and Shadow of the Second Sun, Cyclonus from B308), `put-onto-battlefield` counter amounts (Nine-Lives Familiar), the `damage-to-player-prevented` trigger event (Selfless Squire), `player-effect` `extraLoyaltyActivation` (The Chain Veil), batched `sacrifice` triggers (Camellia), graveyard permissions read at the announced X (Lurrus). Not reached, in rank order, still on their B294 records: Lim-Dûl's Vault, Aminatou's Augury, Odric, Firebender Ascension, Expropriate, Mari, Gilded Drake, Semester's End, Boseiju, The Unagi of Kyoshi Island and the rest of the list.
